ammonia.reason: Moderate deamination of amino acids during 120-180d ripening, not long-aged grana level.

animal_barnyard.reason: Isovaleric acid 12-86 mg/kg + p-cresol/indole from pasture and Brevibacterium rind smear; described as animal.

bitter.reason: Moderate accumulation of hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin proteolysis, balanced by salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: pH ~5.7 with residual amino acids and galactose gives moderate Maillard when heated.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by mesophilic starters in raw milk.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic acid 81-141 mg/kg + hexanoic 21-40 mg/kg from lipolysis by milk lipase and starters.

creaminess.reason: Fat 33.4%, FDM ~52% with semi-cooked pressed paste gives smooth mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed semi-cooked curd at pH ~5.7 retains calcium phosphate, cohesive not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Moisture 36.4% and 4-month ripened pressed body gives firm sliceable alpine texture.

floral_honey.reason: Pasture-derived terpenes plus phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol; noted fruity in mountain cheeses.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids; low caprylic signal.

malty_nutty.reason: Hazelnut/boiled-milk note from Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal and 2,3-butanedione plus propionic 20-1750 mg/kg.

melt.reason: pH 5.5-5.9 with intact para-casein and 36% moisture flows well for raclette-type use.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Low 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from rind fungi; natural brushed rind only.

oil_off.reason: 33.4% fat releases moderate free oil on heating, not high-fat soft cheese oiling.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol wood-smoke compounds.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic acid 550-1300 mg/kg from heterofermentative metabolism and pH ~5.7 gives mild tang.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata curd lacks pH 5.2 demineralized stretchable casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl disulfide-trisulfide from methionine catabolism plus cooked-curd H2S; boiled-milk note.

sweet.reason: Residual galactose, proline and diacetyl/acetoin mask acidity with milky sweetness.

umami.reason: Glutamate release from 24-week proteolysis enhances savory broth background.
